# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 14 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-13 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level13_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 14 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-13 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-13, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-15+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-14 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd, Archives of Nethys aonprd.com, and
# legacy.aonprd.com, all three byte-for-byte identical): base attack bonus
# genuinely rises to +10 (14 * 3 / 4 = 10, up from 9 at level 13), base
# Fortitude/Will (good saves) genuinely rise to +9 (14 / 2 + 2 = 9, up from
# 8), base Reflex (poor save) stays +4 (14 / 3 = 4, an integer-division
# coincidence with level 13), Channel Energy's die count stays 7d6
# ((14 + 1) / 2 = 7, an integer-division coincidence with level 13, since the
# die count rises only every odd cleric level), and the flat domain spell
# slot count stays 7 (a level-14 cleric still casts only up to 7th-level
# cleric spells; 8th-level cleric spells first appear at level 15, verified
# against all three primary sources' raw spells-per-day table rows). The Good
# domain's Touch of Good sacred bonus genuinely rises to 7 (14 / 2 = 7, up
# from 6 at level 13) via the same pre-existing formula, not re-derived.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level14
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:14
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
